db-query.name: Database Query
db-query.description: Execute a WordPress database query and display results
db-query.code:
<?php
global $wpdb;

// Example: Get recent posts
$results = $wpdb->get_results(
    "SELECT ID, post_title, post_date FROM {$wpdb->posts} WHERE post_status = 'publish' ORDER BY post_date DESC LIMIT 10"
);

TSM\Services\OutputFormatter::format_as_table($results);

option-get.name: Get Option
option-get.description: Retrieve and display a WordPress option value
option-get.code:
<?php
// Change 'option_name' to the option you want to check
$option_name = 'siteurl';
$value = get_option($option_name);

echo "Option: {$option_name}\n";
echo "Value: ";
print_r($value);

transient-check.name: Check Transient
transient-check.code:
<?php
$transient_name = 'your_transient_name';

$value = get_transient($transient_name);

if ($value === false) {
    echo "Transient '{$transient_name}' not found or expired.";
} else {
    echo "Transient: {$transient_name}\n";
    echo "Value: ";
    print_r($value);
}

post-meta.name: Get Post Meta
post-meta.description: Retrieve all meta data for a specific post
post-meta.code:
<?php
$post_id = 1; // Change to your post ID

$meta = get_post_meta($post_id);

echo "Post ID: {$post_id}\n";
echo "Meta count: " . count($meta) . "\n\n";

foreach ($meta as $key => $values) {
    echo "{$key}: ";
    print_r($values);
    echo "\n";
}

api-request.name: External API Request
api-request.description: Make an HTTP request to external API
api-request.code:
<?php
$url = 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1';

$response = wp_remote_get($url);

if (is_wp_error($response)) {
    echo "Error: " . $response->get_error_message();
} else {
    $body = wp_remote_retrieve_body($response);
    $data = json_decode($body, true);
    
    echo "Status: " . wp_remote_retrieve_response_code($response) . "\n\n";
    print_r($data);
}
